author: XtraMajestical
body: As i noticed once a game is full in Avicus on nebula a Premium member can join, but after that there is a further cap saying the game has reached maximum capacity, but when you have payed to be able to join a full game and you cant, it can be annoying sometimes and dishonest. I noticed that on some servers it kicks not Premium members so that Premiums can join but that is just as bad so that would be a bad option. If the 'Maximum capacity' cap could be removed for Premiums it would mean that the bit about 'being able to join full games' would be ensured but it it probably more completed than just removing the cap im sure anyway so im unsure.

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
Credit Multipliers:
Same but not too necessary as most things you use w/ credits are usually in the hub (if you are happy with your badge)
Join Full teams:
Same for each rank, if the team is full it is no longer joinable. Completely misleading as "join full teams" is not even possible, so why even have it there? YOUR LYING TO US AVICUS.
Choose your team:
Can't choose your team if its full.
Premium Sweet in Teamspeak:
Meh, barely anyone goes there anymore. All donor ranks have the same permissions on teamspeak, only the picture is different lol
Backpack Slots:
Unless you start buying the cheapest things in the in game store your never gonna have it filled
/go command:
There is usually only 1 or 2 games going on. A simple /where will find the player he/she is in one of 2 games. Even now with being able to find people in game from the forums ruins the whole idea and it simply makes it useless. Only difference is a non-donor has to add the players name on the sites URL and he knows where the player is. All donors have to do is /go

Really all ranks are exactly the same to the point where the lower ranks have just a tad bit less backpack slots and a lower credit multiplier. Otherwise the same. If your gonna buy a rank get the diamond rank because purchasing it for a certain amount of months isn't even worth it anymore. in 9 months of a total purchasing gold you've practically paid the same amount as diamond and in a year its even more. In a year you've paid exactly the same amount as diamond donor for emerald and remember, it still does not have the highest perks. Diamond is the best since its just a bit better through credit multipliers, backpack slots and you don't have to pay $50 to $60 each year. Otherwise still a waste of money... Better to get an alt account any other game that is popular or just use it somewhere else irl or upgrade your PC. Just don't get a donor rank.

replies.body:
They are intended to be less of a product, and more of a symbol of commitment or support for the server... That said... we do intend to add more bonuses to them.

Premium users shouldn't be able to join past the hard max, but can on the soft max. Up to like 18/16 on a map for example, depending on the rotation.

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body:
I hope you know that we greatly appreciate your contributions to the server. It's apparent that the two issues (lag and fast hit) that you describe haven't gotten the attention that you believe they deserve. Understand that we put forth significant time (often hours, days or potentially weeks) into diagnosing issues like the one you describe, so don't begin to think that we don't care about this particular issue. 

Avicus is unique in that it was started by me and the development of it has always been lead by me, so I assume full responsibility and take such criticism personally on some level. As much as I'd like to recruit some additional talented developers, we're not really able to anymore. If you don't like the progress that you're seeing on Avicus, there are many other servers to explore, but it's awesome if you've remained dedicated to this server. I hope we get to the bottom of the whole lag thing because we have cool things in the works that started in November and early December.
